description_en: Modifies the configuration of active O&M tasks on a community-compatible ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 修改Clickhouse社区兼容版集群的主动运维任务配置
name: ModifyActiveOperationMaintainConf

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence cycle. Valid values:

Month: monthly

Week: weekly
parameters.help_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周
parameters.name: cycle_type

parameters.help_en:
The day of the recurrence cycle.

If CycleType is set to Month, this parameter specifies the day of the month. Valid values are 1 to 28. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple days.

If CycleType is set to Week, this parameter specifies the day of the week. Valid values are 1 to 7. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple days
parameters.help_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the maintenance window. Use the HH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the maintenance window. Use the HH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可维护时间段的结束时间。格式为[unk]hh:mmz-hh:mmz[unk]（utc 时间）
parameters.name: maintain_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the configuration is enabled. Valid values:

1: Enabled.

2: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否生效，取值说明：

1：是。
2：否
parameters.name: status
